original_prompt: A gust blows across a dry dandelion, detaching seeds that drift away while the seed head becomes depleted.

initial_condition.description: A visible left-to-right gust supplies the force that removes the dandelion seeds.

pre_event_image_prompt: A realistic fixed close side-view photograph of one full dry white dandelion seed head on its stem at the left of a blue-sky frame. The complete round seed head is intact and dense before seeds detach. Fine grass and nearby wisps bend gently toward the right to make a left-to-right breeze visible. Leave most of the right side as clear open sky for drifting seeds. One continuous 1280x704 landscape frame.
text_policy: pre_event_image_prompt is used verbatim for image generation
